purpose: The Merchant Portal API allows merchants to manage their accounts, view settlements, invite users, and download transaction reports.

components.name: Portal Gateway
components.evidence: Portal Gateway receives the calls of the Merchant web app and passes them to portal-backend, after it has asked Keycloak if the token of the user is valid.

components.name: portal-backend
components.evidence: portal-backend is the service with the business logic.

components.name: portal-db
components.evidence: portal-db is the PostgreSQL database with the settlements and the merchant users.

components.name: Keycloak
components.evidence: Keycloak is the identity provider that holds the user accounts.
